cards.verse_text: But if anyone who is unclean eats meat from the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people. If one touches anything unclean, whether human uncleanness, an unclean animal, or any unclean, detestable thing, and then eats any of the meat of the peace offering that belongs to the LORD, that person must be cut off from his people.”

cards.card_text: Anyone who eats the fat of an animal fit for a food offering to the LORD, or eats blood, must be cut off from his people.
cards.verse_text: “Speak to the Israelites and say, ‘You are not to eat any of the fat of an ox, a sheep, or a goat. The fat of an animal found dead or mauled by wild beasts may be used for any other purpose, but you must not eat it. If anyone eats the fat of an animal from which a food offering may be presented to the LORD, the one who eats it must be cut off from his people. You must not eat the blood of any bird

cards.card_text: God says anyone who offers a burnt offering or sacrifice but doesn't bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting must be cut off from his people, even a foreigner living among the Israelites.
cards.verse_text: Tell them that if anyone from the house of Israel or any foreigner living among them offers a burnt offering or a sacrifice but does not bring it to the entrance to the Tent of Meeting to sacrifice it to the LORD, that man must be cut off from his people.

cards.card_text: By day three it's tainted, and whoever eats it has profaned what is holy to the LORD and must be cut off from his people.
cards.verse_text: If any of it is eaten on the third day, it is tainted and will not be accepted. Whoever eats it will bear his iniquity, for he has profaned what is holy to the LORD. That person must be cut off from his people.

cards.card_text: And God is serious: anyone who doesn't humble himself must be cut off from his people, and anyone who does any work on this day, God says He will destroy.
cards.verse_text: On this day you are not to do any work, for it is the Day of Atonement, when atonement is made for you before the LORD your God. If anyone does not humble himself on this day, he must be cut off from his people. I will destroy from among his people anyone who does any work on this day.

cards.verse_text: But if a man who is ceremonially clean and is not on a journey still fails to observe the Passover, he must be cut off from his people, because he did not present the LORD’s offering at its appointed time. That man will bear the consequences of his sin.
